note: Converted from the pre-migration corpus's scripts/routing-corpus.json (positives/negatives) into forge's cases schema as part of the typography plugin-decompose port. M2 corpus of record, built fresh at authoring time (no prior routing corpus existed). Positives span imperative/diagnostic/symptom/indirect phrasings for DESIGNING a typography system from a brief. Negatives are drawn ADVERSARIALLY from the description's own NOT-for fence: typography-tokens (realization/token vocabulary), typography-lettering (no-token history/metrics questions), material-design-typography-tokens, component-forge, and design-system-hub -- plus the color-domain analogs (make-palette, check-colors) as extra precision against the nearest cross-domain sibling shape (a generator->verifier creative-decision skill). Renamed typography-system-author -> typography-system-design 2026-07-09 per ADR-0001 (verb-form grammar).
